hours: Monday: Closed | Tuesday: Closed | Wednesday: Closed | Thursday: Closed | Friday: 7:00 PM – 12:00 AM | Saturday: 6:00 PM – 12:00 AM | Sunday: 7:00 – 11:00 PM

activities: BioMedCorp Haunted House walkthrough; The Cube Horror Experience; The Resistance Roadhouse (VIP lounge); The Central District (queue experience with live stage shows); VIP Lounge with bars; Gift shop
extra_notes: VIP tickets include skip-the-line access to VIP Lounge (up to 1 hour), one beverage ticket, and option to control group size (4+ Thurs/Sun, 6+ Fri/Sat). General admission available online and at door, first-come-first-served. Season passes available (non-transferable, must pick up in person with ID). The Cube is a separate 5-minute experience (up to 4 guests per session, requires signed waiver). Military discount: $5 off with valid ID at ticket counter. Group discounts available for 15+ tickets online. Free on-street and lot parking. Fully indoor attraction. Wheelchair accessible with alternative routes available. Average wait times under 1 hour; fastest nights are Thursdays and early-October; busiest are Fridays and Saturdays. Strobe lights and fog machines present. No costumes, flip-flops, photography inside attraction, or outside food/beverages allowed. Not recommended for individuals with heart conditions, pacemakers, epilepsy, respiratory issues, pregnancy, or sensitive skin. Age 13+ recommended; babies/toddlers not permitted. Children pay same price as adults. No refunds.
